item.title: Keyphore 0.1.1
item.description:
Keyphore 0.1.1
Adds nine App languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Italian, and Spanish.
System language follows the first supported language in your macOS preference list, falling back to English. Manual language changes apply immediately and are saved. Diagnostic test details and dates are localized, and longer status text can wrap.
Sparkle update windows and macOS file dialogs continue to use the system language. Keyphore’s own update messages follow the App language.

Keyphore 0.1.1
App 现支持英语、简体中文、繁体中文、日语、韩语、法语、德语、意大利语和西班牙语，共 9 种语言。
跟随系统时按 macOS 首选语言列表依次匹配，无匹配时使用英文。手动切换立即生效并保存。诊断测试详情和日期已本地化，较长的状态文字可自动换行。
Sparkle 更新窗口和 macOS 文件对话框继续跟随系统语言；Keyphore 自己的更新提示跟随 App 语言。

item.title: Keyphore 0.1.0
item.description:
Keyphore 0.1.0
Show Codex task status on the NuPhy Air65 V3 main backlight. Supports Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 13 or later and a wired USB connection.
This release fixes interrupted tasks remaining active, late Hook events reviving completed tasks, managed removal of Codex configuration, quit during setup, and unavailable keyboard health reporting. It reduces background setup polling and refines the About page, Quit button, and panel icon.
The App and DMG are Developer ID signed and Apple notarized.

Keyphore 0.1.0
通过 NuPhy Air65 V3 主背光显示 Codex 任务状态。支持 macOS 13 或更高版本的 Apple Silicon Mac，键盘需使用 USB 有线连接。
修复中断任务仍显示运行、迟到的 Hook 事件重新激活已完成任务、移除托管配置、设置期间退出及键盘健康状态显示问题。减少后台配置检查，重新排版关于页面，并改进退出按钮和面板图标。
App 和 DMG 均已使用 Developer ID 签名并通过 Apple 公证。
